title: Classical Molecular Dynamics of HIV-1 Envelope gp120 at 50°C
author: Bennett, Ashley
license_note: Zenodo record metadata license field: cc-by-4.0
materials: A total of 250, 5-μs trajectories were run for closed gp120 at 50°C. The Amber22 software package with pmemd CUDA implementation in the CHARMM36 force field and TIP3P water model was used for simulations. A 150-Å octahedral box was used to allow for V1/V2 and V3 dislocation during simulation. Both systems were neutralized with 150 mM NaCl. Ten thousand steps of energy minimization were performed with 1000 steps of steepest descent minimization with restraints (500 kcal/mol·Å) on protein. A second unrestrained energy minimization consisting of 10,000 steps and 1000 steepest descent steps followed. Minimization was followed by 20 ps of NVT heating with restraints (10 kcal/mol·Å) applied to protein atoms and a subsequent 5 ns of NPT equilibration with no restraints, with a constant temperature of 323.15 K maintained using a Langevin thermostat (96), and pressure of 1 atm was maintained with isotropic position scaling. Two hundred fifty nanoseconds of unrestrained simulations in the NVT ensemble was performed to equilibrate the system, followed by 5 μs of production simulation in the NVT ensemble. steps.title: System preparation and solvation
steps.instruction: Build a closed gp120 model, place it in a 150‑Å octahedral box, solvate with TIP3P water, apply the CHARMM36 force field, and neutralize with 150 mM NaCl using Amber22 pmemd‑CUDA.

substeps.instruction: Create the protein system in the desired conformation.
Define a 150‑Å octahedral periodic box to accommodate V1/V2 and V3 loop movements.
Solvate the box with TIP3P water molecules.
Assign CHARMM36 parameters to protein, water, and ions.
Add Na⁺ and Cl⁻ ions to achieve 150 mM NaCl and neutral overall charge.

steps.title: Restrained energy minimization
steps.instruction: Perform 10 000 minimization steps (including 1 000 steepest‑descent steps) with a positional restraint of 500 kcal·mol⁻¹·Å⁻² on all protein atoms.

steps.title: Unrestrained energy minimization
steps.instruction: Run a second minimization of 10 000 steps (including 1 000 steepest‑descent steps) without any restraints.

steps.title: NVT heating with restraints
steps.instruction: Heat the system for 20 ps in the NVT ensemble while applying a 10 kcal·mol⁻¹·Å⁻² restraint to protein atoms.

steps.title: NPT equilibration without restraints
steps.instruction: Equilibrate for 5 ns in the NPT ensemble with no restraints, maintaining 323.15 K (50 °C) using a Langevin thermostat and 1 atm pressure via isotropic scaling.

steps.title: NVT equilibration (250 ns)
steps.instruction: Run an unrestrained NVT simulation for 250 ns to further equilibrate the system before production.

steps.title: Production MD runs (5 µs each)
steps.instruction: Execute 250 independent trajectories, each 5 µs long, in the NVT ensemble at 323.15 K using the same settings as equilibration.

steps.title: Set nonbonded and integration parameters
steps.instruction: Calculate electrostatics with Particle Mesh Ewald (12 Å cutoff, 10 Å switching distance), constrain hydrogen atoms with SHAKE and hydrogen‑mass repartitioning, and use a 4‑fs integration time step.
